description: Defines classes and structures for representing, grouping, and managing certificate errors and warnings within a certificate validation process, including CertError, CertErrors, and CertPathErrors.

classes.name: CertError
classes.description: Represents an individual error or warning related to certificate processing, including severity, identifier, and optional parameters.

classes.name: CertErrors
classes.description: A collection of CertError objects, providing methods to add, query, and debug errors and warnings.

classes.name: CertPathErrors
classes.description: A collection of CertErrors grouped by certificate in a chain, with methods to access errors for specific certificates or overall.

methods.name: CertError::ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CertError for debugging.

methods.name: CertErrors::Add
methods.description: Adds an error or warning with specified severity, id, and optional parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::AddError
methods.description: Adds a high severity error with optional parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::AddWarning
methods.description: Adds a low severity warning with optional parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing all errors and warnings.

methods.name: CertErrors::ContainsError
methods.description: Checks if a specific error id exists in the collection.

methods.name: CertErrors::ContainsAnyErrorWithSeverity
methods.description: Checks if any error of a given severity exists.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::GetErrorsForCert
methods.description: Retrieves or creates error bucket for a specific certificate index.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::GetErrorsForCert (const)
methods.description: Retrieves error bucket for a specific certificate index if it exists.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::GetOtherErrors
methods.description: Retrieves errors not associated with any specific certificate.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::ContainsError
methods.description: Checks if a specific error id exists in any bucket.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::ContainsAnyErrorWithSeverity
methods.description: Checks if any error of a given severity exists in any bucket.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::ContainsHighSeverityErrors
methods.description: Shortcut to check for high severity errors.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing all errors in the chain.
